_note: Chopshop-Aided-Design palette library. Each palette recolours an existing trace so the CAD structure (geometry, nodes, layout) is untouched -- only the colour vectors change. 'background' names the entry that should take the largest area of the source; 'colours' is the full set, ordered background-first then by role importance. An optional 'map' pins exact source->target pairs and always wins over the heuristic.

_roles.background: largest-area colour in the source becomes this

palettes.name: Red & White on Cream
palettes.note: Bold painterly red and off-white flowers, dark green/brown foliage, clean cream ground. Bright, classic, vintage.

palettes.name: Light Blue & White on Charcoal
palettes.note: Soft ethereal cyan-blue flowers with pale blue accents, white/silver foliage, dark charcoal ground. Moody, elegant, gallery.

palettes.name: Turquoise & White on Black
palettes.note: Vibrant turquoise flowers with deeper blue shading, white/silver foliage, solid black ground. High contrast, dramatic, night-time.

palettes.name: Cool & Luxe
palettes.note: Deep plum and sage for an expensive, moody elegance; ivory blossoms for softness; charcoal background with metallic silver accents. High-end hotel linens and gallery walls.

palettes.name: Warm & Sunny
palettes.note: Fiery terracotta and burnt orange for golden-hour warmth; mustard accents on the flowers; cream base with olive-green foliage. Summer tables and picnics.

palettes.name: Pop & Playful
palettes.note: Pastel rainbow bursts on the petals, crisp black background for maximum punch, tiny lime-green buds. Bold, joyful, collect-the-whole-set energy.
